about: Startup credit programs a founder can apply to. Each row was read on the provider's own page on its checked date, and link is where the application or sign-up starts. Programs change: read the source page before you apply. Edit this file by pull request; catalog/check.py guards it.

rows.amount_note: Between $500 and $120,000 in cloud credits during the first year, with discounted services in years two and three. Credits apply against a monthly limit for virtual machines, storage and other cloud services.
requirements: Early-stage, for-profit company fewer than seven years old
At least one of: paid employees beyond founders, active non-friends users, initial revenue, or VC funding
Plan to scale infrastructure with Akamai Cloud as one of the primary providers
New account with a corporate email on the company domain, a valid credit card and a working website
Corporate entity in the account's Company field
Not an existing Akamai Cloud customer, MSP, systems integrator or reseller
rows.term: 3 years (credits in year one, discounts in years two and three)

traps.expiry: first-year and unused credits do not roll over month to month or into later years
other: Usage above the monthly credit limit is charged for that month.
The page does not state the discount rate for years two and three.
GPU and inference are not named among the services credits apply to.

apply_steps: Create a new Akamai Cloud account with a company-domain email, a valid credit card and your corporate entity in the Company field.
Submit the Rise intake form on the program page with your startup and cloud needs.
Wait for review; the page promises a status update within two weeks.
Join the discovery call if invited, then onboard once accepted.

rows.amount_note: AWS Activate Credits start at $1,000. AWS says select participants may get more, up to $5,000 in total.
requirements: AWS account on a Paid Tier Plan (free account plans are not eligible)
Pre-Series B: bootstrapped, self-funded or funded up to and including Series A
Founded within the last 10 years
A functioning website or public profile
New to Activate Credits, or asking for more than previously received
AWS account email must use the same domain as the application; free email providers are rejected
Founders is the tier for startups with no Activate Provider Org ID

traps.expiry: each grant has its own expiry date, shown in the Billing console; AWS will not extend it
other: Upfront fees for Savings Plans and Reserved Instances are not covered
AWS Marketplace is not covered, except third-party models on Amazon Bedrock
Credits only offset charges from the billing cycle they arrive in onward, not past bills
Startups on AWS China Regions are not eligible
Kiro startup credits exclude startups with active Activate Credits, so apply for Kiro first if you want both

apply_steps: Upgrade your AWS account to a Paid Tier Plan.
Open the Activate apply link and sign in or join AWS Startups.
Use an AWS account email on the same domain as your application.
Submit the Founders application for self-funded or bootstrapped companies.

rows.amount_note: Up to one year of Kiro Pro+ for 2, 10 or 30 users (Starter, Growth or Scale tier). At the $40 per user per month Pro+ list price (kiro.dev/pricing, read 2026-11-02), that is $960, $4,800 or $14,400 (computed here); Kiro states seats, not dollars.
requirements: Early stage to Series A startup
Official business email matching the startup's domain
An AWS account ID using a matching email
No active AWS Activate Credits

Not in an excluded country or region: Argentina, Belarus, Brazil, China, Cuba, France, Germany, Iran, Italy, Mexico, Poland, Russia, Spain, Syria, UAE, North Korea, and the Crimea, DNR and LNR regions
Sign in to Kiro with AWS IAM Identity Center, not Builder ID or social logins
The application form sits behind AWS sign-in

traps.expiry: credits expire one year after issue to your AWS account
other: Offered for a limited time only
Kiro can charge extra for users beyond your tier, or for a plan above Pro+
After the credits, billing moves to standard Pro+
AWS suggests Kiro credits first, then Activate Credits

apply_steps: Confirm you are an early stage to Series A startup with an official business email on your startup's domain.
Make sure you have an AWS account ID that uses a matching email, and no active AWS Activate credits.
Submit the application form linked from the Kiro startups page.
Wait for the rolling-review email; approved credits are added to your AWS account automatically.
Sign in to Kiro with AWS IAM Identity Center, not Builder ID or social logins.

rows.program: AWS Activate credits through Mercury perks
rows.amount_note: Up to $5,000 in AWS Activate Credits for Mercury customers. If you already redeemed less than $5,000 in AWS credits, you get only the difference up to $5,000.
requirements: A Mercury business banking account (Mercury lists business banking at $0 per month)
Business name and email on the AWS application must match the Mercury account
No more than $5,000 in AWS credits already redeemed through another third party
AWS Activate rules: pre-Series B, founded within 10 years, Paid Tier Plan

traps.expiry: each grant has its own expiry date, shown in the AWS Billing console
other: Credits are not added on top of earlier AWS credits
A mismatch between the AWS application and the Mercury account gets the application rejected

apply_steps: Open a Mercury business account.
Open the AWS perk page in your Mercury dashboard and follow its redeem steps.
Apply to AWS Activate with a business name and email that match the Mercury account.

rows.amount_note: A fixed credit amount, recurring for 12 months, plus discounted startup pricing that continues after the credits. AssemblyAI does not state the dollar amount.
requirements: Early-stage startup, pre-seed to Series A; bootstrapped teams welcome
Building a product with voice or audio at its core
Launching within 6 months, or already in production
Short application covering what you build, your stage and your backers; reviewed within a week

traps.expiry: credits recur for 12 months
other: Discounted pricing does not apply to LLM Gateway
Standard pricing phases in after the program

apply_steps: Open the AssemblyAI Startup Program page and choose Continue.
Answer the form: products, company status, product category, customer stage and fundraising stage.
Give expected usage over the next four months and what would prompt integration in 30 to 60 days.
Submit and wait for the review email.
Use the credits that arrive in your console after approval.

rows.amount_note: $10,000 in Cloudflare credits for usage-based services, with no minimum funding. R2 is capped at $10,000, and core security and networking features are free. Workers AI is not covered for incoming startups; its $2,500 cap applies to existing startups until December 1, per the page.
requirements: Company incorporated no more than 10 years ago
Bootstrapped or self-funded, under $1M raised
For-profit business with a business email on the company domain (no personal email)
Live, publicly accessible website Cloudflare can verify
Public presence on LinkedIn, X or GitHub
Actively developing a technology product
First-time applicant (never approved into the program before)
Cloudflare account with a valid payment method on file
Not an educational institution, personal blog, consultancy, agency, MSP or reseller

traps.expiry: credits last one year or until used up, and Cloudflare grants no extensions
other: The terms block still names $50,000 for Workers AI without tiers, which conflicts with the program page.
The general eligibility list also says funded up to Series B and funded within the last 12 months, which conflicts with the Tier 3 bootstrapped criterion.
AI Gateway and Registrar fees are not covered by credits.
Existing Cloudflare enterprise customers cannot use the Startup Plan.
After the credits expire, Cloudflare bills the card on file.

apply_steps: Confirm you are for-profit, under 10 years old, under $1M raised, with a live website and a company-domain email.
Open the Cloudflare for Startups application page.
Submit the application with your Cloudflare account details.
Wait for the confirmation email; Cloudflare says review takes up to 48 hours.

rows.amount_note: Kick-off credits of $1,000 to $25,000 for Denvr AI Compute Services. Up to $500,000 more in reward credits, earned from compute spend.
requirements: AI startup, research team, enterprise or other qualified team building AI applications
Denvr evaluates fit with program goals, AI development focus and resource requirements
Application form asks for company name, position, phone, email, website and address; incorporation is not stated
Agree to Denvr's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
rows.term: Varies by program fit, with tiered transitions to paid services

traps.expiry: length of access varies by program fit; no fixed date stated
other: The $500,000 figure is a ceiling for reward credits, earned from compute spend.
Existing customers earn credits through referrals, co-marketing and feedback rather than the start-up grant.

apply_steps: Open the AI Ascend page and fill the application form.
Enter contact details, company name, position and website.
Agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, then submit.
Wait for Denvr to review fit, then follow onboarding.

rows.amount_note: 12 months of the Scale plan with 33,000,000 characters. The $5,500 figure is ElevenLabs' own valuation ("More than $5,500+ in value"), not a cash credit.
requirements: Startup or company with fewer than 25 employees when it applies
A valid business email
A business or monetization strategy for a long-term product, not a one-off project
No agencies, consulting firms or SMBs
No products for children aged 18 or under
Not an existing enterprise customer
One application per company
rows.term: 12 months, or until the 33M characters are used

traps.expiry: the plan converts to Free after 12 months, or once 10,000 credits are left
other: The terms license your content to improve the services; opt out in the Data use menu of account settings.
Characters cannot be resold or exchanged.

apply_steps: Confirm your company has fewer than 25 employees and a long-term product.
Open the grants application page and apply with a business email.
Wait for a decision, which ElevenLabs says comes within one week.

rows.amount_note: Every approved team starts with a $1,000 Startup pack. The $2,500 Scale pack unlocks at $1,000 a month of fal spend and the $5,000 Growth pack at $2,500 a month, each added on request.
requirements: Team based in Europe or Asia
Real users, meaningful traction or revenue, or backing from an institutional investor
Generative media is core to the product
A fal account
A short intro call is usually part of approval
One application per company every 3 months

other: Teams outside Europe and Asia cannot use this program. fal points them to its YC, a16z or Entrepreneur's First deals, or to pay-as-you-go.
The higher packs need $1,000 or $2,500 a month of fal spend.
The terms let fal use anonymized or aggregated data derived from your inputs to develop AI models.

apply_steps: Confirm your team is based in Europe or Asia.
Open the apply form on the fal Startup Program page.
Share your traction or funding and your plans for fal.
Add a partner referral code if you have one.
Meet the fal team for a short intro call.

rows.amount_note: FounderPass says free members get $25,000 to $100,000 in AWS credits, set by an unnamed partner. Its own FAQ says a company just starting out should expect much lower.
requirements: Free FounderPass membership
Company under 10 years old
Less than $25,000 in earlier AWS Activate credits
Active website and up-to-date LinkedIn company page; website domain matches the business domain
An active 12-digit AWS account
Short form, then a meeting with the partner, who sets the amount from stage, existing credits and spend
rows.term: expiry set by AWS, given on approval

traps.expiry: set by AWS; terms given on approval
other: The partner is not named on the page
Approval takes 10 to 40 days
FounderPass may earn a commission on this offer
The 20% to 60% savings depend on partner agreements and approval

apply_steps: Join FounderPass for free.
Open the request link and complete the short form.
Check your email for instructions.
Schedule a short meeting with the partner, who confirms your credit amount.

rows.program: Hyperstack lifetime discount for NVIDIA Inception members
rows.amount_note: No credits. Inception members get a lifetime 20% discount on on-demand accelerated compute.
requirements: Accepted into NVIDIA Inception (so incorporated, under 10 years old, with a working website)

other: It is a discount on paid usage, not free credit.
The page's member price tables disagree with each other, so per-hour rates are left out.

apply_steps: Join NVIDIA Inception through NVIDIA's form linked from the Hyperstack page.
Wait for acceptance into Inception.
Use the Inception discount on Hyperstack on-demand services.

rows.amount_note: A 50% discount, not a credit: up to 10 IDE subscriptions, 10 team or learning tool subscriptions and 10 JetBrains AI subscriptions, for five years. Startups in a JetBrains partner's network get six months free (up to 10 licenses in total) and then the 50% discount.
requirements: Privately owned company
Evidence the company was established within the last five years
Company website or other discoverable online presence
Commercial licenses only (no personal licenses)
One discount per organization, subsidiaries included

traps.expiry: the discount ends five years after approval or when the 10-per-category limits are used
other: An order that pushes a category past 10 licenses is charged at the regular rate.
You still pay half of list price.

apply_steps: Confirm your company is privately owned and was established within the last five years.
Gather evidence of your company's founding date and a website or online presence.
Open the apply section on the JetBrains Startups page and submit the form.
Buy up to 10 licenses of each type at 50% off.

rows.program: Lambda offer for NVIDIA Inception members
rows.amount_note: $1,000 in Lambda Cloud credits for on-demand GPU instances. Credits also cover persistent storage.
requirements: NVIDIA Inception member (so incorporated, under 10 years old, with a working website)
Lambda reviews and approves each application
One grant per company
Valid credit card
Located in, and paying with a card from, a listed country (the list includes the United States)
rows.term: 12 months from the date credits are applied

traps.expiry: credits are valid for 12 months from the date they are applied to an account
other: Submitting an application does not guarantee credits.
The age limit comes from Inception membership, not from Lambda's page.

apply_steps: Join NVIDIA Inception first.
Open the Lambda offer page and apply for the Inception credits.
Have a valid credit card from a listed country ready for the review.

rows.amount_note: $300 in Supabase credits over one year for new Supabase customers. Mercury also lists an ElevenLabs grant of 12 months and 33 million characters, with no USD value stated. Microsoft for Startups (up to $5,000 Azure) and GitHub ($10,000, VC-funded only) are each partner's own program and are not counted here.
requirements: A Mercury business banking account (Mercury lists business banking at $0 per month)
Supabase: new customers only
ElevenLabs: one grant per company, full-time founders, under 25 employees
GitHub: outside equity funding up to Series B
rows.term: varies by perk; Supabase credits run one year

traps.expiry: Supabase credits run over one year
other: Each partner applies its own terms

apply_steps: Open a Mercury business banking account; Mercury lists business banking at $0 per month.
Open the Mercury perks page and choose the Supabase perk.
Follow the redeem steps on that perk page as a new Supabase customer.
For ElevenLabs, confirm you are a full-time founder with fewer than 25 employees, then redeem the same way.

rows.program: Microsoft for Startups (standard path, no referral code)
rows.amount_note: $200 of Azure credit at sign-up, usable for up to 90 days. Business verification raises the total to $5,000 (another $4,800) for up to 180 days. Usage milestones then raise it to $25,000, $50,000 and $150,000, based on the number of Azure workloads and sustained spend.
requirements: Develop a software-based product or service the company owns
Privately held and for-profit
Headquartered in a country where Azure is available
No more than $350,000 of lifetime free Azure credits
Not raised Series C or later
Not an educational institution, government organization, consultancy or agency; no cryptocurrency mining
A new personal Microsoft account with no prior Azure offer; work, school and company-domain accounts are refused
Identity check with a personal LinkedIn account
Business verification that the startup is a registered legal entity, for the $5,000 milestone
$25,000 milestone: 5 or more Azure workloads for 60 days; $50,000: 7 or more; $150,000: 10 or more and about $3,000 a month of usage for 60 days
rows.term: $200 for up to 90 days; $5,000 for up to 180 days after business verification; 2 years from the $25,000 milestone

traps.expiry: The $200 stage lasts up to 90 days from sign-up. After business verification, the $5,000 stage lasts up to 180 days. If a stage's requirements are not met in time, the sponsorship ends and the subscription converts to pay as you go.
other: Credits must be activated within 90 days of accepting the program agreement, and extensions are not available.
GPU-enabled infrastructure is listed as an Investor Network benefit, not a standard one.
Third-party Foundry models (Anthropic included) and Marketplace purchases are not covered.
GitHub usage draws on the credits only after the Azure subscription is linked as GitHub's payment method.
Each milestone workload must stay above $1 of spend for all 60 days.

apply_steps: Create or use a new personal Microsoft account with no prior Azure offer; company-domain accounts are refused.
On the Microsoft for Startups page, choose Get started now, then Continue without a code.
Verify your identity with a personal LinkedIn account.
Create your Azure account with profile, billing address and a payment card to unlock $200.
Complete business verification within 90 days to reach the $5,000 milestone.

rows.amount_note: Up to $15,000 in MongoDB Atlas credits. The amount depends on stage and investment partner, and MongoDB does not list per-tier amounts. The tiers are Inspire, Grow, Innovate and Scale.
requirements: 7 years old or younger
Series B or earlier
Focused on a single software product or service (no development shops or agencies)
Not previously accepted for the maximum credit offer; past participants may get top-ups
Active company website and LinkedIn profile
Apply through a VC or accelerator partner, or directly if you have none
rows.term: Activate within 30 days. Credits of $500 last 6 months; larger credits last 12 months

traps.expiry: the promo code must be activated within 30 days; credits of $500 expire after 6 months and larger credits after 12 months
other: Developer Support is free for the first 30 days, then starts at $49 a month (payable with the credits).
Promo codes apply only to future charges, not past usage.

apply_steps: Open the MongoDB for Startups page and check you meet the eligibility list.
Select Apply Now and complete the application form.
Name your VC or accelerator partner if you have one.
Activate the promo code within 30 days of receiving it.

rows.amount_note: Free months of the Business plan with Notion AI: 6 with a select partner and 3 with a business website and domain email. Companies under 10 employees get 1. Business costs $20 per member, billed annually. Notion values the offer at up to $12,000 for 100 employees.
requirements: Not a paying Notion customer
Work email on the company domain (no Gmail or Outlook)
Fewer than 100 employees
No previous Notion promotion
Valid business website for the 3-month offer
Affiliation with a select Notion startup partner for the 6-month offer

traps.expiry: the free period ends after 1, 3 or 6 months
other: Companies under 10 employees get the 1-month trial, so most early startups get 1 month unless a partner refers them.
Solo applicants, parked websites and personal-only social profiles also drop to the 1-month trial.
Incomplete business information also drops the offer to 1 month.

apply_steps: Use a work email on your company domain, not Gmail or Outlook.
Open the Notion startups application and enter your company website and employee count.
Name your Notion startup partner if you have one, for the 6 month offer.
Submit the form and wait for the offer.

rows.amount_note: No cash grant. The page promises free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners but names no partner and no amount; members request benefits in the member portal.
requirements: Officially incorporated, with the incorporation date given in the application
Less than 10 years old
Working website
Clear use case for NVIDIA technology
Actively operated by at least one founder
Company pitch deck in the application
Not a consulting or outsourced development firm, crypto company, cloud service provider, reseller or public company
rows.term: Free membership with no stated end

other: Members must keep product and company details updated in the portal to remain eligible for benefits.
The public page lists no partner credit amounts; Lambda, Scaleway and Hyperstack state their Inception offers on their own pages.
Scaleway's NVIDIA page still says Inception requires at least one developer; NVIDIA's own page now says at least one founder.

apply_steps: Confirm the company is incorporated, under 10 years old, with a working website.
Open the Apply Now link and enter business and product details plus the incorporation date.
Submit the application and wait for approval.

rows.amount_note: The US program gives up to $12,000 of public cloud credits for 12 months, plus 6 hours with an engineer. The EU program states EUR 10,000 for the same level. The SCALE level, for Series A and later, gives up to $120,000 (EUR 100,000 on the EU site).
requirements: Selected pre-seed or seed startup
At least a proof of concept or MVP that can run on OVHcloud
Needs cloud infrastructure soon
Not an NGO or association, and not a past Startup Program member
Apply by form, then answer a follow-up email
Incorporation is not stated

traps.expiry: vouchers must be used within the 12-month program or they are lost
other: GPU credits cover only RTX5000, V100 and V100S instances; all other GPUs are excluded.
Dedicated servers and VPS are not covered.
Non-eligible products are debited to the payment method on the account.
Invoices above the remaining voucher balance are not paid by vouchers automatically.

apply_steps: Open the program page and fill out the form.
Submit it, then watch email for a request for more information.
Reply promptly with the details asked.

rows.program: Runpod Startup Program, Starter and Venture tiers
rows.amount_note: The Starter tier gives $1,000 in credits and the Venture tier gives $5,000. Credits work on Pods, Serverless, Clusters and Storage. Growth Track is a spend match: a $25,000 commit adds $10,000 in bonus credits, and a $50,000 commit adds $25,000.
requirements: Starter: raised under $1M
Venture: a portfolio company of a verified VC (the page names a16z, Neo and South Park Commons) that raised under $5M
Growth Track: raised over $5M
Tiers are based on funding raised, which Runpod may verify
Existing customers are not eligible for Starter or Venture credits; they can still apply for Growth Track
rows.term: Credits expire 1 year after issue in every tier

traps.expiry: credits expire 1 year after issue
other: The Growth Track bonus needs an upfront commitment of $25,000 or $50,000.

apply_steps: Open the application form from the Runpod Startup Program page; no Runpod account is needed.
Use your company email and enter your funding, workload, website and LinkedIn.
Choose Starter, or name your verified VC for the Venture tier.
If approved, redeem the emailed credit code on your Runpod billing page.

rows.amount_note: EUR 9,000 in cloud credits over 6 months, not renewable, with on-demand access to a customer success manager. No dollar amount is shown because the page states euros only.
requirements: Entity under 5 years old
Fewer than 50 employees
Not an existing Scaleway customer, unless moving up from the Founders stage
Minimum cloud consumption of EUR 500 a month
Startup that has validated its proof of concept (pre-seed to seed)

traps.expiry: credits are valid 6 months and are not renewable
other: The EUR 500 monthly minimum consumption is a spend commitment.
Applications are reviewed within 21 business days.

apply_steps: Confirm your entity is under 5 years old, has fewer than 50 employees and has a validated proof of concept.
Plan for the minimum cloud spend of EUR 500 a month.
Open the Early Stage Program page and choose Apply to this Program.
Wait for review, which Scaleway says takes up to 21 business days.

rows.amount_note: EUR 1,000 in cloud credits, valid 12 months and not renewable, usable on Scaleway's cloud products. No dollar amount is shown because the page states euros only.
requirements: Entity under 5 years old
Fewer than 50 employees
Not an existing Scaleway customer

traps.expiry: credits are valid 12 months and are not renewable
other: Support is self-serve only, with no customer success manager.
Applications are reviewed within 21 business days.
Consumption above the voucher amount is billed to the startup.

Open the Founders Program page and choose Apply to this Program.
Complete the application form.
Wait for review, which Scaleway says takes up to 21 business days.

rows.program: Scaleway Startup Program for NVIDIA Inception Members
rows.amount_note: Up to EUR 42,000 in cloud credits for Inception members, against EUR 36,000 for regular members. The page also gives 12 months of Advanced Support (about EUR 700 a year), one certification and one social media mention. No dollar amount is shown because the page states euros only.
requirements: NVIDIA Inception member
Meets the Scaleway Startup Program requirements (the Founders and Early Stage pages list: entity under 5 years old, fewer than 50 employees, not an existing Scaleway customer)
New members of the Scaleway Startup Program only

other: Benefits do not apply to existing members of Scaleway for Startups.

Confirm you are new to the Scaleway Startup Program.
Open the Scaleway page for Inception members and choose Apply to this Program.
Complete the application form and wait for review.

rows.amount_note: Up to $100,000 in AWS credits, or 20% to 50% off monthly AWS spend, through an unnamed AWS partner. The partner sets the amount after a manual review.

Already spending at least $100 per month on AWS
Live website and a company LinkedIn or Crunchbase profile
Manual approval by Secret's team

Needs existing AWS spend, so a new account does not qualify

Sign up or sign in to Secret.
Enter your website, your LinkedIn or Crunchbase profile and last month's AWS spend.
Wait for manual approval by Secret's team.

rows.amount_note: The Atlas perk list names $5,000 of AWS Activate Credits, for new users only. It also names $5,000 or more of Azure credits through Microsoft for Startups. It names $100,000 of Cloudflare product credits through the Cloudflare Startup Program. Atlas also gives $2,500 in Stripe product credits for the first year. Those cover Stripe fees, not compute.

Perks open in the Atlas Dashboard after the Atlas application is approved
Each partner may apply its own eligibility rules

Open the Perks tab in your Atlas Dashboard and claim the AWS, Azure or Cloudflare perk.

rows.provider: Tenki (Tenki Cloud, LLC, owned by Luxor Technology)
rows.amount_note: $10,000 in free credits on approval, for Tenki Sandboxes, GitHub Actions runners and the AI Code Reviewer. Tenki also matches purchased credit 1:1 up to $40,000, which needs your own spend.

Submit the startup application form.

rows.amount_note: A spend match, not free credit. Vast matches verified compute spend dollar for dollar in credits, up to a cap set per startup at approval.
requirements: Actively training models, running inference or scaling a production workload
Committed paid spend on Vast
Vast reviews every application and sets the offer by company stage and use case
Incorporation is not stated

Matching credits wait on verification of the spend.

Describe your company stage and workload; Vast reviews every application.
If approved, accept the offer with its credit cap.
Spend on Vast; Vast matches verified spend dollar for dollar in credits.

rows.amount_note: Up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits. The amount depends on the offer your Activate Provider holds, and a later, larger offer pays only the difference.

Pre-Series B, founded within the last 10 years
AWS account on a Paid Tier Plan
Each Org ID works once

Upgrade your AWS account to a Paid Tier Plan.
Apply at the Activate apply link using the Org ID and the email your provider has on file.
Ask your provider to confirm your affiliation within 30 days.

requirements: Invite only
For startups ready to scale after Activate Portfolio
Reached through your AWS account manager

other: No public application

apply_steps: Join AWS Activate and use up your Portfolio credits first.
Talk to your AWS account manager about the AI Startups credits.
If you have no account manager, use the AWS startups contact page.

rows.amount_note: Evaluation access to AMD Instinct GPUs through partner clouds. The page states no price. Duration and capacity vary by partner.
